observations.title: RISK-001: Open Critical, High or CAT I weaknesses
observations.description:
Open Critical, High or CAT I weaknesses. Lists each open Critical, High or CAT I item for the AO. This is risk, not a package defect, so it does not affect the readiness score or level; open Critical items are critical issues and High/CAT I items are high issues for the --fail-on gate.

- [high] Stale privileged accounts [a1ba1b3a]: Open High / CAT I weakness (AC-2).
- [high] High-severity patches past due [d4b0da7c]: Open High / CAT I weakness (SI-2).

observations.title: RISK-002: Accepted risks are listed for the AO
observations.description:
Accepted risks are listed for the AO. Items with an approved deviation (risk acceptance) are listed so the AO sees every risk that is being carried rather than fixed. Informational; does not affect the score or level.

- [info] Weekly (not daily) audit review: risk accepted [02be1f1e]: Risk accepted (Low / CAT III, AU-6).
